description: A previously mastered item is no longer considered mastered. Milestone notification — not a BKT posterior dump. Authoritative per-item model state lives in spec-server's private database.

learnerDid.description: The learner who forgot this item.

itemId.description: The forgotten item identifier. Format: dict:lemma:{id} or dict:pattern:{id}.

itemType.description: Whether this is a vocabulary lemma or a morpheme pattern.

forgottenAt.description: UTC timestamp when forgetting was detected.

sessionId.description: The session during which forgetting was detected.

encounterCountBeforeForgetting.description: Total encounters before this forgetting milestone.

sourceEventRef.description: Opaque, server-resolvable reference to the private tools.spec.private.learner.spectrumState update (spec-server) whose W/kappa decay crossing detected this forgetting. Correlation token only — it does NOT carry priorW/posteriorW or any (W, kappa, F) value inline; the authoritative per-node state stays private. New records MAY instead use the structured tools.spec.event.defs#privateRecordRef shape (refType 'spectrumState'). See RECORD_REFERENCE_HIERARCHY.md S2.

register.description: Register of content where item was last encountered.
